capabilities: chat with OpenAI-compatible models using note, folder, and imported web page context
read, create, edit, rename, and delete notes through built-in tools
search the web with provider fallback and fetch URLs
run MCP servers, user-authored SKILL.md skills, and an optional Agent mode
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node.js APIs). MCP tools and web access are disabled by default and must be enabled in settings; file tools can modify the vault, so the README includes extensive safety and privacy warnings. Bilingual English/Chinese documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to converse with AI models while letting them read and modify vault notes, Canvas, and external tools.

relations.evidence: OpenAI-compatible chat providers, including local Ollama and LM Studio endpoints.
Web search queries are sent to Bing and, when a reliable fallback is needed, Baidu, Sogou, or 360.

summary: AI assistant panel that chats with OpenAI-compatible models, edits notes and Canvas, searches the web, and runs MCP tools and skills.
